operating_notes.text: Received an order for up to 30 units of EVOQ360 Home Lifts valued at ₹2.00 crore.

Launched Fire-Rated Steel Doors (Swing Metal Fire Doors) with a 120-minute fire-resistance rating certified by Gujarat Test House, Ahmedabad, under IS 3614:2021, for the domestic commercial and industrial market.

timeline.summary: Amar Chinubhai Doshi, Promoter and Managing Director of Aaron Industries Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter-held shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹27.33 Cr (+13.4% YoY), net profit ₹2.32 Cr (-15.6% YoY).
Board of Directors, chaired by **Nanjibhai Maniya**, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share (5% on face value ₹10) for FY2025-26, subject to AGM approval on May 16, 2026.
Aaron Industries received an order worth ₹2 crore from Gulf Elevators Private Limited for home lifts on October 13, 2026.

Aaron Industries launched Fire-Rated Steel Doors (Swing Metal Fire Doors) with a 120-minute fire rating certified by Gujarat Test House under IS 3614:2021, for the domestic commercial and industrial market.

upcoming_events.description: Execution deadline for Gulf Elevators home lifts supply order

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at the ensuing Annual General Meeting
